test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T and T and U are sitting in a row facing towards the north (not necessarily in the same order), P sits second to the left of S and third to right of U. Only two persons sit between R and Q. Q is not neighbour of S. Who sits to the immediate left of P ?
solution:
**Given: **P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in a row facing towards the north.

1) P sits second to the left of S and third to right of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d12ed92665047baa36134ca5468cee24ae33c4603d2de2e46f3da8d34406d847.png] 

2) Only two persons sit between R and Q.

3) Q is not neighbour of S.

After positioning R and Q only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2978e97e7e370abd138f55d6e52f10cc091ce21034bf56ee873758b66e098360.png] 

Thus, T sits to the immediate left of P.

Hence, **"Option 2" **is the correct answer.
